description:
HumanOS revolutionizes the $38B humanoid robotics industry by solving the critical training data bottleneck through tokenized human actions. The platform creates a decentralized marketplace where users upload POV videos of daily actions (opening bottles, using computers, etc.) and receive tradeable ERC20 tokens in return.

Companies fund action-specific pools and purchase these tokens to access training videos for their robots. The innovative economics create a deflationary model—when companies burn tokens for data access, the remaining token supply decreases, increasing value for holders. This creates passive income for creators while providing robotics companies with 90% cost reduction ($48/hour → $1–5/video) and 1000x more diverse data than traditional motion capture.

The platform features:
- Automated price discovery (Uniswap integration)
- AI-powered action classification (LLama Vision API)
- Quality assurance via staking (10 USDC per submission)
- Multi-network deployment (Flow EVM, Hedera, Zircuit testnets)
- Decentralized video storage (Walrus integration)
how_its_made:
Smart Contract Architecture
- Solidity + Hardhat: Core protocol (HumanOS.sol) + ERC20 tokens (ActionToken.sol)
- OpenZeppelin: Reentrancy protection, access control, token standards
- Uniswap V2: AMM-based price discovery with factory/router pattern
- Multi-network deployment: Hedera Testnet, Zircuit Testnet

Frontend Stack
- React + TypeScript + Vite: Modern, type-safe web app
- Tailwind CSS + Shadcn/ui: Responsive design system
- Wagmi + Privy: Wallet + social login integration
- React Router: Navigation for creators, companies, and admin

AI & Data Processing
- Llama Vision API: 56–73% accuracy in action classification
- Walrus: Decentralized, censorship-resistant video storage
- @xenova/transformers: Client-side video analysis

Key Innovations
- Tokenized Data Ownership: Videos mint ERC20 tokens as data shares
- Deflationary Economics: Token burning raises remaining value
- Optimistic Submission: 24-hour challenge window with auto-approval
- Economic Security: USDC staking prevents spam submissions

Notable / Hacky Aspects
- Custom token minting tied to video verification (“data-to-token” pipeline)
- Real-time price discovery via Uniswap integration
- Cross-chain compatibility through multi-network deployment
- Market-driven game theory balancing robotics demand and data supply
